notes.title: The Swimming Pools have Arrived
notes.content: [p]Hi how are you, running a tad late but there is a good reason for that, was living among pandas trying to learn their ways. One day, while eating bamboo (raw bamboo is NOT good) one of the pandas was like "Hey, got any extra bamboo?" (btw, can speak and understand panda now). Simply replied back there's bamboo everywhere (this took place in a bamboo forest (bamboo grows VERY fast)) and the panda was like "Oh yeah."[/p][p]This was the only tale from panda living worth telling. Absolutely do NOT recommend living amongst pandas.[/p][p]Anyway new update yes.[/p][h2]New Location - The Swimming Pools[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/8af412703d30b35acaf423ff01907d94ed0539e9.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Theme - Corruption[/b][/p][p]Only appearing later in Hard Mode, it's a maze filled with water traps and terrible secrets.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/0a3b891612d348f7e7d2fef841b5d439d1859282.png"][/img]There's also a strange new entity wandering the halls...[/p][h2]New Entity - The Enigma[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/b63579a11fc9a41aa1b49b2d60d72619cf8e6388.png"][/img][/p][p]Impossible to defeat and capable of many strange abilities, such as teleportation. Your best bet is to only hide from it.[/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed being able to run on ice.[/p][/*][*][p]Also fixed some weird pathfinding on Restaurant, Alley and Recess.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted a lot of different sounds.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Summer Sale[/h3][p]Survive Society is also in the summer sale so it's time to [i]swim[/i] into savings hahahahahahahahahaahahaaha[/p][h3]Lastly[/h3][p]Ok that's it for this watery update. Now off to live amongst the pandas again. Gotta get at least one tale that has a point yk[/p]

notes.title: Survive Society 1.0
notes.content:
Hi, hello, hi.
How you be doing?

1.0 Version is out and it now says 1.0 on the start screen of the game which is good?

[h3]New Cosmetics[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/8c1780fc491fd7941cfad7030ed87a8c46ad96de.png[/img]
Tank full of copium. It's a back cosmetic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/5a07bca637a3b6f2af1f932052e2c0dcb5471f7e.png[/img]
:^) Mask. What kind of person adds a nose to their smiley face?!?

[b]Other Features/Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*]Level Limit raised to 15.
[*]Max money limit raised to 4000.
[*]Updated the store page graphics.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Re-Fixed equipment being removed from your inventory when a new area loads. (left out a single code line last time it was supposed to be fixed)
[*]Fixed various bugs relating to the head bobbing feature (like not emoting correctly.)
[*]Fixed talent screens in lobby not updating for some clowns.
[*]Fixed cosmetics not showing up for some clowns.

Have everything in place to make new expansions with areas, entities, items, etc.

A Chaos Run can happen in the future if people want, it would be a much harder version of Hard runs with new nightmarish areas and entities.

Can't do an achievement for 100% the discoveries because it can keep being updated with new areas/entities. It's dynamic! 

Also keep reporting bugs if you find them.

ALSO there's lots of hints for possible future things hidden in various areas if you can find them!

[h3]Next Update[/h3]
The Swimming Pools area is next. It was already done a while ago but made a bunch of changes to it so it's much bigger.

[h3]Lastly[/h3]
:^)

notes.title: Head Bobbing Field of View
notes.content:
It's time to head to bobbing views of fields? WHAT
YES!

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[b]Turn off Camera Head Bobbing[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/b09187eae1a7bcf7e562ad5cc53c9983455b5d9c.png[/img]
You can turn off the camera moving when walking in the settings now. This is on by default so change it as you please. It also changes your animations to other clowns though because the head bobbing was tied to the walking animation which in theory was not the best plan but

[b]FoV Slider[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/41916bfbc359361cc82c68741fd6beea3f70dee9.png[/img]
Field of View slider is in the Video Settings now. Min is 45 and Max is 70. Your held item might not show depending on your setting. Default is 55!

Added new particle effect when you cash in a relic which is clown colors:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/bd21c46020d27a2a27f0b7959911ecdd25c6fc56.png[/img]
You see it's clown colors because you play as a clown in this game.

Added some more secret messages in different areas hinting at things:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/22316e86c778e32f212b0cddbeee8ff9dfd71de7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/5b967b33a8aa7eb8d0d5fa6e28240997800dc0ff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/7b299c6bc094f460714d7fb9abcd8110bb40bf85.png[/img]

[b]Relic Protection[/b]
Made it so if a relic drops into the abyss it will appear back in the original spawn point so they aren't lost forever. This only applies to relics though so if you lose your flashlight it's gone for-ev-errrrr
This might not be a perm feature if it causes problems in the future tho cause this seems like it might just do that.

[list]
[*]Added actual EDM music for The Club area.
[*]Made it so your crosshair will only turn red if target is defeatable.
[*]Luggage Mimic can be stunned now BUT not defeated. Also red crosshair doesn't work on the mimic because that would defeat the purpose of a mimic.
[*]Increased attack reach for Wood Bat and Pick Axe.
[*]Updated Achievement icons again.
[*]Changed Item spawning so higher priced items will now spawn more on later areas.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed all problems with the Continue/Leave Neet Mobile buttons not appearing correctly.
[*]Fixed Entity defeat effects not playing when defeated.
[*]Fixed crosshair not turning on the red indicator with melee weapons.
[*]Fixed some button context being switched around.
[*]Fixed falling into the abyss not triggering on the Window Washing area when you slip off the edge. Was just going to remove the puddles but redid the fall triggers instead.
[*]Fall triggers now detect multiple times instead of once now.
[*]Fixed Park lighting making various things dark.
[*]Fixed TOO MUCH KNOWLEDGE message not triggering on clients.
[*]Fixed clowns appearing on the background of the tally screen sometimes.
[*]Re-Fixed entities like the Gnome sometimes being partially invisible or fully invis sometimes. IT BETTER WORK THIS TIME
[*]Fixed items briefly overlapping when switching them around in inventory.
[*]Fixed Raccoon Monster doing nothing after it's first attack.
[*]Fixed Restaurant area being buggy.
[*]Fixed a lot of bugs with Giant Brain pathfinding.
[*]Fixed DarZo Phaser particles being buggy.
[/list]

[h3]Lastly[/h3]
Finished a new trailer with all new things added, will post on the youtubes soon.

notes.title: Book Club, Sprinting and More!
notes.content:
Guten Tag! Hoi, hoe gaat het?

Uhh, another patching update with some..... THINGS.

First off before we get to book club and running and more, added a thing for early access-ers (sp?) It's a back cosmetic in the store you can buy for 1 dollar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/5feb52830d783ef00aa33ab4b53a0e62f5f5ad35.png[/img]

It's a limited time thing so it will disappear from the store after early access or it will go up to 9999 dollars or other.

[h3]New Feature - Sprinting[/h3]

You can now sprint for a bit (tiny rhyming intended)
Hold shift to run, it plays a running sound to let you know you are running (very intuitive!)

[h3]New Area - Book Club[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/822492da96ea71246ab466bbe1341239814f409f.png[/img]

It's kind of like a dance club but there's giant floating books everywhere.
Added this because there was only 1 area that had giant brains and wanted another. Only appears on Hard runs.

[h3]New Cosmetics[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/219b4c159b481d34a6c13034fc441745ac401720.png[/img]
In addition to the early access thing there's 5 new cosmetics.
[list]
[*][b]Oversized Nose[/b] - Head
[*][b]Oversized Ears[/b] - Head
[*][b]Kick me Sign[/b] - Back
[*][b]Foot Wings[/b] - Back
[*][b]Classic Clown Nose[/b] - Head
[/list]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
The background now blurs when you pause or open various menus.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/954fc5e255b5e89ff5613b2cf2838417895ab8ae.png[/img]
(Fancy!)

Added pictures for button context instead of letters, like RMB (right mouse button) is now a mouse pic:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/a9bcb29447617eb847aae51a76421f5e0a704c3e.png[/img]
THINK RIGHT AND LEFT MOUSE BUTTONS ARE BACKWARDS THIS WILL BE FIXED IN NEXT UPDATE

[list]
[*]Added graphical effects to clown defeats (like fire particles on fire defeats)
[*]Redid Talent Selection menu and updated Talent icons.
[*]Maximum Locations for Normal runs is now 6 from 5.
[*]Flashlight shadows aren't complete garbage anymore. This only works on best graphical settings tho.
[*]Realtime shadows in general are better now too.
[*]Hard run areas will now no longer repeat.
[/list]

[h3]New Talents[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Better Stamina[/b]: Sprint stamina increased.
[*][b]Savvy[/b]: Better shop prices (doesn't stack with other clowns)
[*][b]Negative Nancy[/b]: Negative status effects don't last as long.
[*][b]Swimming Exempt[/b]: Move through water as though you were walking.
[*][b]Data[/b]: Start with an info tablet in your locker.
[/list]

[h3]New Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Discover 20 areas
[*]Cash 1000 relics
[*]Unlock 5 talents
[*]Purchase 5 cosmetics (doesn't include emotes)
[*]Discover 5 and 10 Items
[*]Reach level 10
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed items being frozen in place or following clients when switching them around in your inventory.
[*]Birthday present no longer spawns on Normal because you can't go to the Birthday Party on normal.
[*]Fixed Blind Date not noticing when you voice chat. (also will probably completely remake blind date model in future, don't like how it turned out)
[*]Fixed Gremlin playing the walk animation when it's running.
[*]Fixed Lava being walkable in Recess.
[*]Fixed invisible entities or partially invis entities from appearing (like the gnome)
[*]Fixed leaf piles not affecting clients.
[*]Fixed Luggage Mimics not seeing clients.
[*]Fixed a lot of triggers not seeing clients sometimes (like falling in the airport)
[*]Fixed that weird graphical bug in the entrance of the Frying Chambers.
[*]Fixed the invisible blocks in Restaurant area.
[*]Fixed defeat sounds playing multiple times? This might need more fixing tho.
[/list]
There was alot more bug fixes but they were small and boring.
Can't fix that thing when items sometimes float when first spawning.

[h3]Lastly[/h3]
Ok update done, remember to buy the early access item from the store because it's time limited!!

notes.title: The Minion of the Dark Clown Awakens
notes.content:
Happy birthday!

It could be someone's birthday or close to it so there's no need for judgmental looks.

[h2]First Boss Entity - The Dark Clown's Minion[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/ce572074937d81241c26fb82186488036d231ddd.png[/img]

Found in it's birthday party lair, you can challenge this dark entity when certain tasks and sacrifices are made.

To defeat it you can attack it with weapons you have but there's also another way to damage it which you will have to figure out! Has various attacks, Stomping, Clown Horn and Charging.

This is only a servant of a far greater evil.

[h2]New Area - Birthday Party[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/a1277efb23037d9c12090269dc255742b294ea0d.png[/img]

Theme - Social

You can only reach this destination if you have 2 Gifts on board your Neet Mobile when traveling to a new area.

To challenge the Dark Clown's minion there are 2 carved stones before the gate:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/6ae7b75842f0fcd882766e90180f718c2592ee82.png[/img]

Sacrifice Gifts by placing them on the stones:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/d1ea81fdc3dfbcc5c39d0e55a599451fe6ab7f3e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/6b2cef41b7be57823a91e24b478a48e558ab87c5.png[/img]

Then the door will open. There's a video on twit and tiktok if you want a video demonstration.

[h2]New Weapon - Clown Horn[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/433afef26c4ee134260d1f62a9f62188e1f0988c.png[/img]

If you manage to defeat the Dark Clown's Minion then you'll have a chance to get this dangerous but hilarious weapon.

[h2]New Entity - Luggage Mimic[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/f2c44c4f5715ef0dba21c5d0d8231a19893732ac.png[/img]

The Luggage Mimic will now appear in the Airport Lobby in Hard Mode. You can't defeat or discover them.

[h2]More Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updated the store page with new screenshots.
[*]Decorated Kindergarten area more.
[*]Added Airport Lobby to hard mode.
[*]2 New Achievements: Discover the Birthday Party area and Discover the Clown Horn item.
[*]Increased Search Distance on Relic Locator item.
[*]Cash Stack Relic value has been increased and will no longer have the value of $1.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed Defeat text sometimes overlapping.
[*]Fixed most DarZo Phaser bugs
[*]Fixed Info Tablet not updating when first found.
[*]Fixed monsters not disappearing on client when defeated sometimes.
[/list]

[h2]Lastly[/h2]
Ok almost done with all features. Next things will be better UI Icons and spell/grammar checks, More talents, achievements and cosmetics.

Also will try to get rid of bugs.

Also need to make a new trailer.

Also will add a sprint button but not going to add any new animations to go with it.

Ok that's it for this update, happy birthday!

notes.title: Capybaras, Karma and Blind Dates
notes.content:
PREPARE TO FACE KARMA FOR YOUR ACTIONS!!!!

[h1]Karma[/h1]

Your karma stat now does something after previously doing NOTHING.

Different things can happen depending on your karma shown on your status screen in the Neet Mobile cockpit. It's harder to have positive karma than it is to have negative (This says A LOT about society!)

[h2]Negative Karma - Restaurant and Blind Dates[/h2]
If you have Negative Karma then this nightmare might appear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/a97b481aa71af5464e2046850ba6ee0933751afc.png[/img]
New Area - Restaurant
Theme - Social

Don't make any noise here by bumping into tables or knocking over wine bottles or you might incur the wrath of the...

[h2]Blind Date[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/5b388b57908253e8dc967224add24154438e407d.png[/img]
These can't see you unless you make noise, but they will run you over if you get in their way. There's only a guy entity atm, in the future there will be both guy and girl ones that will randomly appear. 

[h2]Positive Karma - Capybaras[/h2]

If you manage to get positive karma then you get capybaras.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/d58dcefd4dd88b56ea6a01b8194cbceb63a52674.png[/img] 

New Area - Capybara Spa
Theme - Recreation

A pleasant place with no dangers and easy access to relics. It also has capybaras you can pet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/bfd3cff23e17716aa283943bd4231f069b57300e.png[/img]

This is the exact same model from Capybro:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2559540/Capybro/
Also designed the area to look like the game.

Positive Karma stuff is rarer than negative stuff, so you might not see this area even if you have positive karma. (again this says a lot about society!!)

[h3]New Item - Gift[/h3]

An additional way to gain karma is the new Gift item.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/7972ea489ae1d7a88cc14f8c0805daaa13c8b99c.png[/img]
You can give these to Normies for karma, it's slightly secret like most ways to gain karma but all you have to do is use the fire button (Right Mouse for pc controls) while looking at a normie while holding the gift. There's no button context for it.

[h3]New Achievements and a Bug Fix[/h3]
[b]Achievement[/b]: Discover the Capybara Spa
[b]Achievement[/b]: Discover the Restaurant

[b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed Hard Stat not showing correctly on the stat screen.
Will fix the Info Tablet not showing correct info in next update.

[h3]Lastly[/h3]
Next update will have a boss. Will prob make it Dark Souls-Like with charge up attacks and such.
Keep reporting bugs, will fix them all before the full release.

notes.title: Raccoon Update
notes.content:
Todays update was made by raccoons, for raccoons.

[h2]New Area - Alley[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/d0b9b48cbf4e90039cb25ae98c3317f128db03a4.png[/img]

Alley
Theme: ????

This is a secret area that you need to do something secret to get a chance to access. Has a secret item if you get here too!

It's also completely dark and has a roaming giant raccoon monster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/cc770e4c321a8fffd16d09170f7b474e87511de6.png[/img]

[h2]New Items[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/469ed4c43fbffc49501059a2785caad7f5302d0e.png[/img]
[b]DarZo Phaser[/b]
Freezes most entities. This is one of the first rare spawning items. This design shape was slightly inspired from that gun in that Fifth Element movie because I was rewatching that while making new models.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/4ee81340a90fda2b2bebbfb3681a55d94a5e6a81.png[/img]
[b]TeleDisc[/b]
Use this to teleport you back to the Neet Mobile from where ever you are. So if you are in the Neet Mobile and want to teleport to the Neet Mobile now is your chance!

[h2]Other New Things[/h2]

First of Clown Conditions was added. Your Status Screen in the Mobile Cockpit will show if you have a condition.

The first one is gained if you find one of these strange Tailed Totems. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/a16a488d09aed83d9fe7c2f4820af818ac10240f.png[/img]

New Cosmetic - Raccoon Tail

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/c50ebde9e6853360860e36025047f46a68d5c8b5.png[/img]

Forgot what this was priced at

There is now a Hard Win stat that tracks wins in hard mode.

New Achievements:
[b]Harden[/b]: Win first runs in Hard Mode.
[b]Hardened[/b]: Win 10 runs in Hard Mode.
[b]Dark Alley[/b]: Discover the Alley Location.

Also going to redo the prev achievement icons cause didn't really like how they turned out.

[h2]More Changes and Additions[/h2]

[list]
[*]Hard Mode has a level 5 clown requirement now.
[*]Neet Mobile Weight Limit is now 5.
[*]Normie Potion now has a visible effect when used.
[*]Added more ways to gain experience. Can no longer gain experience when completing <2 areas.
[*]Removed Potato from discoveries and added Fries.
[*]You can now no longer visit the same area twice in a normal run. This will later be added to harder modes.
[*]Gremlins can now open doors.
[*]Redid item spawning so equipment should be slightly more common.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed Clients crashing on Park, Cat Litter and a few others. There was a weird error on the Park and it deleted all Entity spawns so had to replace them. Tried to remember where they originally were but they might be diff. Also Duck easter egg no longer happens on the night version of this area.
[*]Fixed winning run stat not counting on clients sometimes.
[*]Fixed a bunch of other errors that were mostly caused by the new projectiles (Gremlin Balls and Fiend Bottles). Redid projectile stuff so that shouldn't happen anymore.
[*]Fixed Giant Brains not seeing clowns. This was due to trying to fix their voice lines overlapping.
[/list]

[h2]Lastly[/h2]
Next update will either be a Boss monster OR karma related stuff. Also going to probably do something with Capybaras because who doesn't like capybaras.

🦝🦝🦝🦝

Hi how do is? How do is you are be

[h2]New Features, Talents and Stuff[/h2]

[h3]INVENTORY[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/098573d838a18a5a89b8435ac0cd932954863ae1.png[/img]
You can hold up to 3 items at a time. You can hold 4 if you purchase the Society Inventory Bundle™ for $24.99! [spoiler]Ecks Dee it's actually a talent[/spoiler]

Use the number keys to switch between them. You'll drop everything when destroyed by society. Also you still can't carry extra Relics between areas.

[h3]New Talents[/h3]
[b]Satchel[/b]

notes.title: New Patch - Cosmetics, Talents, Leveling and More!

New patch with lots, LOTS

There's 6 talents:

[b]Flashlight[/b]: Start with a flashlight. This is already unlocked for everyone.

[b]Respawn+[/b]: Your respawn timer will increase much slower.

[b]Go Fast I[/b]: Move faster.

[b]Stable Feet[/b]: No longer slip on puddles.

[b]Heat Resistance[/b]: No longer affected by anything fire or heat related (Hot Oil, Flames, Grills)

[b]Crouch Ninja[/b]: Move at the same speed as if you were walking when crouch.

[i]HINT: Crouch will become useful in the upcoming area.[/i]

Select talents on your screen in the lobby.

[h2]Cloud Saves are Enabled[/h2]

Experience, Levels, Collected money and everything is save enabled now.

Max Level is 5 (Temporary)
Max Money is 1000 (Temporary)

There's now a stat screen on the Start menu.

[/list]

Report any bugs on Steam Discussions.
Also give suggestions on balance for exp needed for leveling up and cosmetic prices.

Next update will have a new area and a new entity.

notes.title: Survive Society Out Now in Early Access!
notes.content:
Survive Society is out now in early access, play solo or with other clowns.

For this build, mainly want to test networking and making sure there's no major bugs. After things work then will start adding more areas/monsters/items/etc. Post suggestions/missing features/bugs in the Steam Discussions.

Save files are disabled atm, collected money/exp and some settings won't save for now.

[h3]How to play[/h3]

Press [b]PLAY[/b] to host a lobby, from there, in the in-game lobby you can invite other clowns with a code by pressing the SHOW LOBBY CODE or invite clowns from your friend list with the USE THIS TO INVITE OTHER CLOWNS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/58bc8902f02605f00d5f16a6ec50e7898f17cfcb.png[/img]

Or you can play solo. Sit in the Neet Mobile seats when you are ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/5a7b08c726c821b0088f21b38e07f5c074a442b0.png[/img]

The Neet Mobile will automatically travel to locations. Open the door to start the timer and enter society.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/e481701716bba366e89426da598369040ff87328.png[/img]

Find enough relics and place them in the cash machine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/69ff5c099caeb2f9eec136b81875f1ec34247e3e.png[/img]

The amount you need is displayed next to the money machine.

Close the door and either travel to the next location or go back to Neetdom.

You have to go to a certain amount of locations before returning though. And it has a maximum of 5 runs atm.

There are 6 locations currently: The Park, Grocery Shopping, Frying Chambers, Window Washing, Library and Gas Plumbing. Some locations will only show up when certain conditions are met and locations that were easy will become harder depending on difficulty. Also item spawns and area layouts will change each time.

Game Over happens if you run out of time, or if playing with a group, everyone is killed at the same time. This is to balance group vs solo play.

To join a friends lobby click on the Join button:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/f283503fc73f7cc83ca47096ba33f70dca1f7f55.png[/img]

Enter lobby code or your friends lobby will show up on a list and you can join that way. The friend lobby list is a beta feature and may not work correctly yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/41408543f00edf7696ea264fb6c242f5e53f8650.png[/img]

Also to play with the same group, on the tally screen the host needs to press “Go Again” to play without having to re-invite.

[h3]Multiplayer Stuff[/h3]

This game uses a host/client setup so if the host leaves the run will stop.

Things happen differently on the Host and Client so had to work a lot to sync them. Tried to catch everything but may have missed stuff, so if you find anything related to that post it on the discussions.

Didn't do a whole lot of testing with 4 players so there might be bugs relating to that.

[h3]Voice Chat[/h3]

It's proximity chat so voices come from your player in-game.

BUT transmission might be buggy, you can't send audio over a network, you have to turn it into numbers first then send those numbers over then re-assemble it on the other side and turn it back into audio and make sure it plays in the right order. It's very annoying.

Report if you have any problems with it. If necessary, can just use a premade method like Vivox but wanted to see if this worked first.

Anyway if voice chat programing was a person I would be like Hey Friendo I'm not a fan of yous

[h3]Balance[/h3]

Give suggestions on stuff balance wise. Like if relics are too spread out, monsters too easy/hard, too much time/not enough, etc.

Experience and money isn't saved atm, it will be when stuff is balanced and there are no major bugs.

[h3]Water Shader[/h3]

Look at this water shader:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468491/78660339fbe1e1de1bfd944eb4c53cc7c3e8ec0b.png[/img]

Also admire it in-game (the park). Spent like 2 days making that shader and it uses fresnel effects and everything.

[h3]Lastly[/h3]

Ragdolls might go insane at times.

Flashlights in the lockers are temp so don't get used to them.

No harming the normies/NPCs.

Pls don't make fun of UI graphics they are temp/unfinished.

Suggest missing settings from the settings menu.

Don't get killed by the Giant Brains, they will absolutely roast you.
